items.title: Tim Kelly Interview, 1978-12-03
items.q: he was very popular with Ben Burney at this time.

ctx.x: Yeah. And, what kind of mouthpieces did you all use?

Oh, well, I, of course I always, I used a Selmer Table D, hard rubber mouthpiece for a long period of years. I hadn't become that technical until I got to where I really was interested in learning how to play. But, I then got a Dix to Beal back by 1935. Dix to Beal is in New Orleans, now director of the office at the World War was a hotel. But, anyhow, he had, he was very popular with Ben Burney at this time. And, so the wood-winning people put out this Dix to Beal special. I used that thing for 25 years. I was…
That's, he's one of my all time favorites. Very favorite one. And, to go on down the horn itself. Yeah. What kind of, what kind of horn do you prefer? Or, did the people use there generally?
